text.tspan: Everything below commits or rolls back together —
including the work done inside the listeners.
Step 1 — publish the fact, BEFORE removing the row
inline, on this thread, in this transaction.
publishEvent() does not return until every listener has finished.
Step 2a — the book module reacts: release ownership
Step 2b — the enrollment module reacts: drop enrollments
Step 3 — only NOW remove the student row
